t.label: Received
t.note: When the host first saw it (its clock).

sev.label: Level
sev.note: The severity as a number: 0 debug, 1 info, 2 warn, 3 error (and fatal). A Log's floor is sev >= N.

channel.label: Channel
channel.note: activity: the host's coded events; raw: an entity's uncoded lines (kernel lines, run output), read for its Log.

lineage.label: Under
lineage.note: The row's path and every path above it (host, host/usb1, …): a Log's scope is lineage.contains(the entity's path).

stream.label: Stream
stream.note: Where the page read the row: the activity log, or one entity's raw lines (each in time order).
